reason: The plugin is primarily a per-project usage and cost analytics utility for DSH, because it reads local session logs, aggregates token usage by project/model, converts usage to RMB cost with configurable pricing, and presents the results in a sidebar UI with supporting local endpoints. Its primary user-facing value is project-level LLM token/cost visibility rather than code generation or external search/automation.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 的成本分析插件，读取本地会话日志按项目和模型汇总 token 用量，并按配置价格转换为人民币成本，在侧边栏面板中展示查询结果。
summaries.en: This is a DSH plugin that reads local session logs to summarize token usage by project and model, converts it to RMB cost using configurable prices, and presents the results in a sidebar UI.

capabilities: Reads and parses local DSH session log files
Aggregates LLM token usage by project and model
Computes estimated RMB cost from token counts and price table
Displays project/model cost and usage in a web sidebar panel
Provides local HTTP endpoints for stats, prices, and health

reasons.code: README states the plugin reads local DSH session logs from ~/.dsh/sessions or $DSH_HOME/sessions and replays session.jsonl(.zstd) entries.
README explains token usage is aggregated by session cwd (project) and model, then converted to RMB using input/cache-hit/output pricing.
README documents a loopback-only API with endpoints /dsh-token-cost/api/stats, /dsh-token-cost/api/prices, and /dsh-token-cost/healthz.
package.json declares this as a DSH web client plugin via dsh.client.platform set to web, indicating a web-facing panel integration.
